decision: Both matches occur only in the unchanged private original; no corresponding archive member exists. Entire file excluded; derivative removes both values.
limitations: Bounded lexical patterns complement Gitleaks and are not proof of absence of secrets.
Pickle/joblib payloads are never deserialized or executed; only recognized zlib/gzip/zip wrappers are decompressed.
Unsupported compression, arbitrary encodings, encrypted archives and binary field semantics are not interpreted.
Only recognized UTF-16 streams are decoded; raw-byte scanning is not a complete search of every possible encoding.
ZIP CRC checks establish member-stream integrity only when the member is fully read.
Source path names and match SHA-256 fingerprints are private; matched values are never written.
